concept: Review and integration: citizenship as active participation, not passive membership
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across understanding decision-making, respecting different views, and contributing beyond yourself — which comes least naturally to you?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real community they're part of and one way to participate more actively

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
